title: Eye of the Cosmos
description: A massive surreal eyeball with a cracked glossy surface and vibrant blue iris floats centrally against a dramatic sunset sky. Sharp blue crystalline spikes radiate outward while colorful liquid streams in purple, teal and blue flow downward into a reflective river below, surrounded by aurora-like lights.
prompt: Surreal floating cracked eyeball with intense blue iris and black pupil, sharp blue crystalline spikes protruding outward with golden edges, colorful liquid streams of purple teal and blue flowing downward like aurora into a dark reflective river, dramatic fiery orange and red sunset sky, mystical cosmic atmosphere, painterly brushstrokes, vibrant yet dark fantasy style
